message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0) and two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Four Wild cards and four Wild Draw Four cards. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by collecting the cards left in opponents’ hands when you finish a round. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down as the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Gameplay** | • Play proceeds clockwise (unless a Reverse changes direction).
• On your turn, you may play one card from your hand that matches either the **color**, **number**, or **symbol** of the top discard card.
• If you cannot play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color cards; otherwise, you can be challenged.) | | **Winning a Round** | When a player discards all their cards, they shout “UNO!” if they have one card left. If they forget, they must draw two penalty cards. The round ends when a player has no cards left. | | **Scoring** | • Add the point values of the cards remaining in opponents’ hands:
 – Number cards: face value.
 – Skip, Reverse, Draw Two: 20 points each.
 – Wild, Wild Draw Four: 50 points each.
• The winner of the round receives those points. | | **Continuing Play** | After scoring, shuffle the discard pile (except the top card) to form a new draw pile and deal a new round. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach the target score (e.g., 500 points) wins. | **Optional Variations** | Variation | Effect | |-----------|--------| | **Stacking** | Players may stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards on top of each other, forcing the next player to draw the cumulative total unless they can counter. | | **No Challenge** | Some groups allow Wild Draw Four to be played without challenge. | | **Custom Decks** | Use themed decks or add extra action cards for house rules. | That’s the core of Uno! Feel free to tweak or add house rules to keep the game fresh.
